post.caption: Mariah Carey's diamond hid in candy. In 2008, Nick Cannon proposed to her with a candy Ring Pop, and her real engagement ring sat where the candy should have been. It happened on the rooftop of her Manhattan apartment, with the Empire State Building lit in her favorite colors. A few days later he proposed again, on a helicopter, and she joked that he sort of kidnapped her. For their second anniversary he gave her a Ring Pop style ring in white gold with diamonds and pink sapphires. The first diamond is reported at 17 carats.
